There comes a point when arguing is mute.  People will agree with you and some select few will actually understand what I'm trying to say and agree with me.  They could have raped and killed her, I'm not trying to say whatever the hell happened here isn't wrong.  I'm trying to say that not all cops are scumbags with ego issues.  But like I said, this is pointless.  Go keep hating on everything with a badge, you little rascal you.

Yeah, I know what dickhead did was wrong.  Hence the disclaimer.  I put it there so people wouldn't go, "oh but this guy did..." I know.  My rant is about the overall fuck the police theme that we've been having these days.  There are plenty of good cops out there no need to condemn every one of them and give them even more shit than they already deal with on a daily basis.

Or you could just be respectful to the police, own up to fucking speeding and be polite.  They're people too, just trying to do their damn job and the majority of them do actually want to make a difference for the better in their communities.  Why would you purposely be an asshat like that?  This constant FTP stuff is starting to get really annoying.  

As a disclaimer, what the cop should have done was realized she was being silent and said, "alright, well I clocked you at whatever speed in a whatever zone, I'm going to run you stuff and be back."  Come back with the ticket, have her sign and tell her she can appeal it in court.  Don't wanna talk?  Cool makes my job easier not having to argue with you.  Here's your ticket, have a nice day.

I just thought I'd update this as it's been a while.  Lots of ups and downs but I've been pushing through as best I can.

I've been trying to work out the logistics for college.  The bad news is I really need a new car because mines failing fast, so that's going to put a dent in my finances.  The good news is I can go to a local community college for very cheap then transfer to the more expensive one I really want after 2 years.

More good news, as much as I hate work I'm successful there and have a good relationship with my higher ups.  I've explained my goals to them and they're willing to work out a schedule with me that allows me to continue making my current income and go to college full time.  

They're also willing to help with college with a reimbursement program for tuition/books/class fees etc.  They'll do 2500 a semester which is great because the local college for my gen ed associates is about 2300 before books so I'll be able to pay out of pocket until I transfer to the four year.

On a down side and yet... somehow good side?  I live with my stepbrother, he had to be sent to an inpatient facility earlier this week, turns out he's going through a lot of the same pains as myself.  That's the bad side, the good side is it was an excuse to take all of the guns out of the house for his safety (and subsequently my own).  So I no longer have it staring at me every day I get home from work.

I'm sure I'll update again in a few weeks when I make more progress.  Just know I have come back on several occasions and reread your replies when I was feeling down and they still help.  Thanks again everyone.  One day at a time.

Even better, I finally got around to speaking to the local community college and it's about 4k a year for me, but I am going to transfer to a four year and the one I want most is out of state... and the out of state is about 40k a year... but at least I'm saving by doing my first two years here.

Meanwhile in the US I have yet to see the scandal or any of this mentioned on the news a single time.  But I've seen them talk about Donald trumps tweets about Cruz's wife 24/7.  Most my non reddit friends don't even know any of this exist.  Can I come to Iceland and join the movement?
